title: The International Peace Museum

services.name: Guided Tour
services.desc: Discover the inspiring stories and powerful exhibits that bring the message of peace to life at the International Peace Museum. Our guided tours offer a unique opportunity to dive deeper into our galleries, led by experienced guides who will share insights into the museum's collection, special exhibits, and the history of the peace movement. Whether you’re an individual, family, or group, our guided tours are designed to engage visitors of all ages. Explore themes of conflict resolution, social justice, and the ongoing pursuit of peace around the world. Tours last approximately one hour and include time for questions and discussion.
